name: Ultimate Predators Speed Duel Deck
extDescription:
Each Speed Duel Starter Decks: Ultimate Predators contains:
• 1 30-Card Rex Raptor Deck
• 1 30-Card Weevil Underwood Deck
• 4 Skill Cards (2 for Rex and 2 for Weevil)
• 2 Ultra Rare variant cards

name: Dinosaur Kingdom
extDescription: All Dinosaur monsters gain 300 ATK and DEF.

name: Nightmare Sonic Blast!
extDescription:
You can activate this Skill while you control "Serpent Night Dragon".
Once per turn, you can reveal the top 4 cards of your Deck, use 1 of the following Skills, depending on the number of monsters revealed.
1: Add one of the revealed cards to your hand.
2: Destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
3 or more: Apply both effects.
Then place the rest of the revealed cards on top of your Deck in any order.

name: Hyper Metamorphosis
extDescription: You can activate this Skill while you control a Level 3 or lower Insect Normal Monster. Discard 2 cards and Tribute 1 Level 3 or lower Insect Normal Monster you control to Special Summon 1 "Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Any damage your opponent takes for the rest of this turn is halved.

name: Hidden Parasite
extDescription: Once per turn, you can change all monsters on the field to Insect until the end of this turn, also, any battle damage your opponent takes is halved for the rest of this turn. You may use this Skill up to twice per Duel.

name: Order to Charge
extDescription: Select 1 face-up Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field when you activate this card. When this card resolves, Tribute the selected Normal Monster and destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Jar of Avarice
extDescription: Target 5 cards in your GY, except "Jar of Avarice"; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Jar of Avarice" per turn.

name: Serpent Night Dragon
extDescription: A dragon created from the soul of a wicked knight.

name: Two-Headed King Rex
extDescription: A powerful monster whose two heads attack as one.

name: Uraby
extDescription: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

name: Crawling Dragon #2
extDescription: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.

name: Tomozaurus
extDescription: Small but vicious, this monster even attacks its own kind.

name: Anthrosaurus
extDescription: Dis man-like dinosawz gotta high I.Q., even tho he's lackin' in da strength depawtment. (Kinda like yooz, if ya had a high I.Q.! Nyaah!)

name: Black Tyranno
extDescription: If the only cards your opponent controls are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Super-Ancient Dinobeast
extDescription: You can Tribute Summon this card in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Dinosaur-Type monster. When a Dinosaur-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned from your Graveyard (except during the Damage Step) while this monster is on the field: You can draw 1 card.

name: Mad Sword Beast
extDescription: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Gilasaurus
extDescription: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way: Activate this effect; your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their Graveyard.

name: Gale Lizard
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

name: Dark Driceratops
extDescription: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Hyper Hammerhead
extDescription: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

name: Element Saurus
extDescription: This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field: • FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK. • EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle.

name: Black Stego
extDescription: If this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Change this card to Defense Position.

name: Gentlemander
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Your opponent cannot attack any monsters except this one.

name: Raise Body Heat
extDescription: A Dinosaur-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Ultra Evolution Pill
extDescription: Tribute 1 Reptile-Type monster; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your hand.

name: Spacetime Transcendence
extDescription: Banish 2 or more Dinosaur monsters from your GY; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand or GY whose Level equals the total Levels of those banished monsters, but it cannot attack this turn.

name: Cost Down
extDescription: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

name: Summoner's Art
extDescription: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: White Elephant's Gift (A)
extDescription: Send 1 face-up non-Effect Monster you control to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Heat Wave
extDescription: This card can only be activated at the start of Main Phase 1. Neither player can Normal or Special Summon an Effect Monster, until your next Draw Phase.

name: Card Advance
extDescription: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your Deck, then place them on the top of the Deck in any order. You can Tribute Summon 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set this turn. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

name: Hunting Instinct
extDescription: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field: Special Summon 1 Dinosaur-Type monster from your hand.

name: Reinforcements
extDescription: Target face-up monster gains 500 ATK until the End Phase.

name: Pharaoh's Treasure
extDescription: After activation, put this card face-up in your Deck and shuffle it. When you draw this card, send it to the Graveyard and add 1 card in your Graveyard (except this card) to your hand.

name: Limit Impulse
extDescription: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 2 "Soul Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). They cannot be Tributed except for a Tribute Summon.

name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Petit Moth" on your 6th turn or later after it was equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: Petit Moth
extDescription: This small but deadly creature is better off avoided.

name: Big Insect
extDescription: A giant ant that dwells in the jungle, it is powerful whether attacking or defending.

name: Basic Insect
extDescription: Usually found traveling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

name: Winged Cleaver
extDescription: Few can withstand the scythe-like arms of this dangerous creature.

name: Kumootoko
extDescription: A massive, intelligent spider that traps enemies with webbing.

name: Alinsection
extDescription: A stag beetle with saw-like head and arms.

name: Insect Queen
extDescription: This card gains 200 ATK for each Insect monster on the field. Cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle this turn: Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

name: Cocoon of Evolution
extDescription: You can equip this card from your hand as an Equip Spell Card to a face-up "Petit Moth" on the field. While equipped by this effect, the ATK and DEF of "Petit Moth" become equal to the ATK and DEF of "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: Man-Eater Bug
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

name: Pinch Hopper
extDescription: When this card you control is sent to your GY: You can Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your hand.

name: Insect Princess
extDescription: All Insect monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position. If this card destroys an Insect monster by battle: This card gains 500 ATK.

name: Gokipon
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Insect-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

name: Bee List Soldier
extDescription: You can Tribute this card and 1 face-up Insect-Type monster, except "Bee List Soldier", to draw 2 cards.

name: Beetron
extDescription: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card you control to the Graveyard to target 1 Level 4 or lower Insect-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position. The effect of "Beetron" can only be used once per turn.

name: Laser Cannon Armor
extDescription: An Insect-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Forest
extDescription: All Insect, Beast, Plant, and Beast-Warrior monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Verdant Sanctuary
extDescription: When a face-up Insect monster is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: Its controller can add 1 Insect monster with the same Level as the destroyed monster from their Deck to their hand.

name: Insect Neglect
extDescription: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish 1 Insect monster from your GY; negate the attack.

name: Worm Bait
extDescription: If you control an Insect monster: Special Summon 2 "Worm Tokens" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You cannot Normal or Special Summon any Level 3 or 4 monsters the turn you activate this card.

name: Enchanting Fitting Room
extDescription: Pay 800 Life Points. Pick up 4 cards from the top of your Deck and Special Summon to your side of the field all Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters among the picked-up cards. Return all the other picked-up cards to your Deck and the Deck is then shuffled.

name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
extDescription: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

name: Amulet of Ambition
extDescription: Equip only to a Normal Monster. If it battles a monster with a higher Level, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK x the difference in Levels (during that battle only). When this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can return it to the top of your Deck.

name: White Elephant's Gift (B)
extDescription: Send 1 face-up non-Effect Monster you control to the GY; draw 2 cards.

name: Eradicating Aerosol
extDescription: Destroy all face-up Insect-Type monsters on the field.

name: Spider Egg
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent declares a direct attack, while you have 3 or more Insect-Type monsters in your Graveyard. Negate that attack. Special Summon 3 "Spider Tokens" (Insect-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

name: Corrosive Scales
extDescription: Target 1 Insect monster you control; equip this card to it. While you control the equipped monster, your opponent's monsters cannot attack Insect monsters, except the equipped monster. While this card is equipped to a monster, each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s), OR activates a card or effect, place 1 Scale Counter on each face-up monster they control. Each monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK/DEF for each Scale Counter it has.

name: Adhesion Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

name: Order to Smash
extDescription: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field when you activate this card. When this card resolves, you can Tribute the selected Normal Monster and destroy 1 or 2 Spell or Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field.
